title: Affine consistency transcript predicate
statement: For a transcript of three optional Boolean values, accept if and only if all three values are present and the product of the signs corresponding to the second and third values equals the sign corresponding to the first; reject if any value is absent.
hypotheses_covered: A transcript of three optional Boolean values
